stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Fir and Elm must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Fir and Elm must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Cedar must precede Ash." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Ash → Birch → Elm → Cedar → Fir
- Ash → Birch → Elm → Fir → Cedar
- Ash → Cedar → Birch → Elm → Fir
- Ash → Cedar → Fir → Birch → Elm
- Ash → Fir → Birch → Elm → Cedar
- Ash → Fir → Cedar → Birch → Elm
- Birch → Elm → Ash → Cedar → Fir
- Birch → Elm → Ash → Fir → Cedar
- Birch → Elm → Fir → Ash → Cedar
